scope: Qualified ideal-gas ten-species h2o2 frozen thermodynamic and TP/HP equilibrium sweeps, independent NASA7/conservation/chemical-potential checks, Calc handoff and shared source/property/console reuse. Closed adiabatic constant-pressure/constant-volume ReactorNet histories of the 29-reaction h2o2 mechanism with independent host kinetics, conservation and declared temperature-rise ignition delay. No transport, flames or other mechanisms.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_cantera.py with a Cantera Python and Calc. Verify independent thermochemistry/equilibrium checks, reactor-history independent kinetics/ignition cases, thermo and reactor handoffs, public authoring and kit integrity/lifecycle probes. A new release must also keep h2o2.yaml byte-identical or requalify kinetics.json/thermochemistry.json.
